questions_and_answers.question: How can I improve my integumentary system?
questions_and_answers.answer: I’m going to answer from a health-perspective. 1. Water is key. Many people forget this very simple concept of staying hydrated. Now we watch in bored amusement when we pee yellow. 2. Good sleep. Hugely underrated player that often gets neglected by many people. “Man, I only got six hours of sleep because of work yesterday night.” More yawns. If you don’t sleep well, your risk of cancer also increases. Sleep well = getting your requisite deep sleep for the brain recovery. 3. Self-care. Stress ages skin, causes weight gain and increases cortisol production. Sure, cortisol is useful for waking us up in the morning, but everything in moderation I suppose. 4. Good nutrition. Control your urges of eating copious amounts of waffles, chocolates, chips etc. Sugar ages cells, so if you want to look younger and healthier, avoid this delicious treat. Unless you have low blood sugar. Otherwise, control yourself! 5. Exercise. Sweat helps get rid of toxins as well as keeping your skin looking fresh…
